meta.title: ARION — Carried by Arion
meta.description: We get to know your foot first, then we make your shoe. Shoes crafted in Türkiye, designed with fit technology and built to be repaired.
meta.ogTagline: We get to know your foot first, then we make your shoe.

hero.title: Carried home.
hero.lead: In myth, Arion carried his rider home when every battle was lost. We build shoes with the same promise: we get to know your foot first, then we make your shoe. And we stay with it for as long as it lives.
hero.kicker: A shoe is a contract of carriage.

myth.title: A child of earth and water, a horse of legendary speed.
myth.body: In Greek myth, Arion is the son of Poseidon, god of the sea, and Demeter, goddess of the earth. When the army fell in the war of the Seven against Thebes, Arion's speed alone carried King Adrastus out alive. Every part of the myth maps to one of our promises.
myth.tableCaption: Traits from the myth and what they mean at ARION

carrier.myth: Carries his rider home safely from battle
carrier.promise: A shoe is a contract of carriage. It carries you home, whatever the conditions.

earthWater.promise: Winter boots and outdoor shoes that grip the ground and stand up to water

speed.promise: Sneakers and movement: The Physics of Motion

immortal.promise: Repairability, the Lifetime Plan and the Shoe Passport

categories.title: Shop by category.
categories.intro: A heel and a winter boot do not share priorities. Each category page explains why we build it the way we do.

fitTwin.title: Same size. Different foot.
fitTwin.body: Size and fit are the most common reasons people return shoes bought online. We compare your foot measurements with the millimetre tables of our lasts and give every model a fit score from 0 to 100, with the reasoning behind it.

steps.measure: Measure your foot: length and forefoot width, in millimetres.
steps.match: Match it to the last: we compare it with each model's last table.
steps.explain: See the reasoning: "Your forefoot is 4 mm wider than this last, we recommend W."

fitTwin.privacy: Foot measurements are protected like sensitive data: separate explicit consent, encrypted storage, one-click deletion. Nothing is stored in guest mode.
fitTwin.sampleReason: Forefoot 4 mm wider → W width recommended

atelier.title: One pair. Seven steps.
atelier.body: For atelier-made models, you can follow your order through every stage of production.

promises.title: Data. Not claims.
promises.body: We back our ideology with numbers. Once live, every metric on the Transparency Board will be calculated from real data.

closing.title: No shoe is immortal.
closing.body: But a brand can refuse to let it die.

manifesto.title: Manifesto
manifesto.lead: In myth, Arion carried his rider home when every battle was lost. That is how we see shoes.

paragraphs.p1: A shoe is the only interface between your foot and the world. It carries your whole weight thousands of times a day. So we treat it not as a fashion object but as a contract of carriage.
paragraphs.p2: We explain why every model is built the way it is. We measure our claims. When a shoe wears out, we call it back to the atelier, not to the bin.
paragraphs.p3: Türkiye cannot win a price war on cheap production. The way to win is added value: design, fit technology, craft and direct cross-border e-commerce.

manifesto.quote: Efsanede Arion, savaş kaybedildiğinde bile sahibini eve taşıdı. Biz ayakkabıyı aynı sözle yaparız.

fit.title: Foot first
fit.body: A size is a label, not a measurement. We calculate fit in millimetres.

explain.title: Explain
explain.body: Every technical claim comes with an answer to "How did we measure this?"

repair.title: Repair
repair.body: Welted soles, replaceable heel tips, resoling. A longer life is a design decision.

measure.title: Measure
measure.body: Return rate, repairs, lifespan. We keep our promises with public numbers.

categories.topuklu: As heel height rises, weight shifts to the forefoot. The shank, the heel axis and the forefoot cushion are there to manage that load.
categories.kislik-bot: A waterproof membrane, a gusseted tongue and rubber that stays flexible in the cold. A welted sole, so it can be repaired.
categories.sneaker: Midsole cushioning and energy return, heel-to-toe drop and a flex line that bends in the right place.
categories.klasik: A leather sole that shapes itself to your foot and a welted build that can be resoled. Made to last a lifetime.
categories.cocuk: A flexible sole, a wide toe box and room to grow. Measuring reminders as the foot grows.
